title: Term Relationships
description: Single source of truth for term relationships within one technology module.

version.description: Schema version. Increment on breaking changes.

terms.description: Map of term_key (snake_case filename without .md) to relationship data.

level.description: Learning level this term belongs to.

file.description: Relative path from the module root to the term file, e.g. 'terms/level_03/closure.md'.

display_name.description: Human-readable term name used as markdown link text.

prerequisites.description: Ordered list of terms that must be understood before this one. Directed edge: this term → prerequisite.

related.description: List of conceptually related terms. Intended to be bidirectional.

module.description: Target term's module folder name, e.g. '03-javascript'.

description.description: One-line description used after the em dash in markdown link syntax.
